## Personality

Mirabel Cotton takes great pride in her deceased family members. She frequently shares detailed accounts of their deaths, including their final words and their appearances in their coffins.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)_

## Traits

## History

Mirabel Cotton is a local individual who interacts with the children in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She frightened young [Dora](../character/dora.md) by telling her stories about her deceased relatives. This behavior led [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to step in and comfort the scared child.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +58 more_
